args.message:
Fix rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money docstring says banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per
FIN-212, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py failures in the nightly build. Switch to the
correct rounding mode.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The docstring already specified banker's rounding, so the implementation is corrected to match the documented behavior and the FIN-212 requirement.

Changes:
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`
- Uses `decimal.quantize` as before; only the rounding mode changes

CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`. Please approve so this can ship in today's release.
